name: Palak paneer
description: Pureed spinach with cubes of fresh cheese.

tcm.note: Spinach is cooling; paneer is neutral-cooling.

ayurveda.note: Both the greens and the fresh cheese are shita, though cream makes it guru.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; the spices are what stop it being cold outright.

histamine.note: Spinach is a SIGHI 3 on its own — this dish is mostly spinach.
